title: Hippocrates father of Pisistratus
summary: Raleigh names Hippocrates father of Pisistratus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Hippocrates, named as the father of Pisistratus. He is not HIPPOCRATES, whose aphorism is quoted on the shortnesse of life. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
